note: Computed by scripts/backtest/question_stats.py from monthly_scores.csv, wb_gold_usd_toz.csv and wb_silver_usd_toz.csv. All figures in percent. Nominal unless the key says real.

wait.better_means: score of 40 or higher (Mixed or better)

price_vs_past.measure: price divided by the CPI of its month, midrank percentile against every earlier month of the World Bank series (from 1960)

monthly_moves.measure: change of the World Bank monthly average price from the previous month, 1971 onward

price_by_year.measure: World Bank monthly average price, USD per troy ounce, 1971 onward; today's dollars use the CPI of the last month

gold_silver_ratio.measure: World Bank monthly average gold price divided by the monthly average silver price, both in US dollars per troy ounce, 1960 onward; what followed is measured on the record window from 1971
